name: Dalmatian Coast
about: Peak Jul–Aug for island-hopping and sailing; May–Jun and Sep offer warm water with a fraction of the crowds.
overview: Medieval walled cities and a thousand-island coastline along the Adriatic, from Split down to Dubrovnik.
costOverview: Coffee and a casual meal stay reasonable — the coastal ferries connecting the main towns are a real, non-trivial cost.
